additional_info.subject: "Power Up 20kW" - Procedure
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Please support me in the procedure of commissioning the station with an additional power module.
I installed an additional power module in the station, a change from 180 to 200 kW.
What is the procedure for commissioning this station in SCB?
Do I need to carry it out with you?
Is it enough to change the number of modules during commissioning in SCB?
If you can please give me step by step instructions.
The station will only be commissioned in January. Station serial number: MP / R8 170002531
With best regards,
